audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar supplementary offerings, equal-law, inadvertent/high-handed sin, Sabbath case, and tassels text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for future land offerings, grain/drink measures, sojourner equality, first dough, communal and individual inadvertent sin, defiant high-handed violation, Sabbath wood-gatherer execution, and tassels with blue cord. Strong anti-xenophobia, anti-legalism, and anti-violence safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: When you come into land of your dwellings that I am giving to you,

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: After you enter the land that I am giving you as a home

original.text: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י תָבֹ֗אוּ אֶל אֶ֨רֶץ֙ מוֹשְׁבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: and you make fire-offering to YHWH, burnt offering or sacrifice, to fulfill special vow or as freewill offering or at your appointed times, to make soothing scent to YHWH from herd or flock,

familiar.text: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:

modern.text: and you present an offering made by fire to the LORD from the herd or flock to produce a pleasing aroma to the LORD—either a burnt offering or a sacrifice, for a special vow or freewill offering or appointed feast—

original.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ זֶ֔בַח לְפַלֵּא נֶ֨דֶר֙ א֣וֹ בִנְדָבָ֔ה א֖וֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֞וֹת רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִן הַבָּקָ֖ר א֥וֹ מִן הַצֹּֽאן

verses.restored: then one bringing near his offering to YHWH shall bring near grain offering of one-tenth ephah fine flour mixed with fourth of a hin oil.

familiar.text: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

modern.text: then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall also present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of olive oil.

original.text: וְהִקְרִ֛יב הַמַּקְרִ֥יב קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהוָ֑ה מִנְחָה֙ סֹ֣לֶת עִשָּׂר֔וֹן בָּל֕וּל בִּרְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין שָֽׁמֶן

verses.restored: Wine for drink offering, fourth of a hin, you shall make with burnt offering or sacrifice for one lamb.

familiar.text: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

modern.text: With the burnt offering or sacrifice of each lamb, you are to prepare a quarter hin of wine as a drink offering.

original.text: וְיַ֤יִן לַנֶּ֨סֶךְ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ית הַהִ֔ין תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עַל הָעֹלָ֖ה א֣וֹ לַזָּ֑בַח לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד

verses.restored: For a ram you shall make grain offering of two-tenths ephah fine flour mixed with third of a hin oil,

familiar.text: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

modern.text: With a ram you are to prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,

original.text: א֤וֹ לָאַ֨יִל֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַהִֽין

verses.restored: and wine for drink offering, third of a hin, you shall bring near as soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: וְיַ֥יִן לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁ֣ית הַהִ֑ין תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: When you make son of herd as burnt offering or sacrifice to fulfill special vow or peace/well-being offerings to YHWH,

familiar.text: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:

modern.text: When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice to fulfill a vow or as a peace offering to the LORD,

original.text: וְכִֽי תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה בֶן בָּקָ֖ר עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ זָ֑בַח לְפַלֵּא נֶ֥דֶר אֽוֹ שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: one shall bring with son of herd grain offering of three-tenths ephah fine flour mixed with half a hin oil,

familiar.text: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

modern.text: present with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil.

original.text: וְהִקְרִ֤יב עַל בֶּן הַבָּקָר֙ מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן חֲצִ֥י הַהִֽין

verses.restored: and wine for drink offering, half a hin, as fire-offering of soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: Also present half a hin of wine as a drink offering. It is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: וְיַ֛יִן תַּקְרִ֥יב לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ חֲצִ֣י הַהִ֑ין אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Thus it shall be done for each bull, or for each ram, or for lamb among sheep or goats.

familiar.text: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

modern.text: This is to be done for each bull, ram, lamb, or goat.

original.text: כָּ֣כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֗ה לַשּׁוֹר֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד א֖וֹ לָאַ֣יִל הָאֶחָ֑ד אֽוֹ לַשֶּׂ֥ה בַכְּבָשִׂ֖ים א֥וֹ בָעִזִּֽים

verses.restored: According to number that you make, so you shall do for each according to their number.

familiar.text: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

modern.text: This is how you must prepare each one, no matter how many.

original.text: כַּמִּסְפָּ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָאֶחָ֖ד כְּמִסְפָּרָֽם

verses.restored: Every native shall do these things thus, to bring near fire-offering of soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: Everyone who is native-born shall prepare these things in this way when he presents an offering made by fire as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: כָּל הָאֶזְרָ֥ח יַעֲשֶׂה כָּ֖כָה אֶת אֵ֑לֶּה לְהַקְרִ֛יב אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: When a sojourner sojourns with you, or whoever is in your midst throughout generations, and makes fire-offering of soothing scent to YHWH, as you do, so he shall do.

familiar.text: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.

modern.text: And for the generations to come, if a foreigner residing with you or someone else among you wants to prepare an offering made by fire as a pleasing aroma to the LORD, he is to do exactly as you do.

original.text: וְכִֽי יָגוּר֩ אִתְּכֶ֨ם גֵּ֜ר א֤וֹ אֲשֶֽׁר בְּתֽוֹכְכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעָשָׂ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֶֽׂה

verses.restored: For assembly, one statute shall be for you and for sojourner who sojourns, an age-long statute throughout generations; as you are, so shall sojourner be before YHWH.

familiar.text: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.

modern.text: The assembly is to have the same statute both for you and for the foreign resident; it is a permanent statute for the generations to come. You and the foreigner shall be the same before the LORD.

original.text: הַקָּהָ֕ל חֻקָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָכֶ֖ם וְלַגֵּ֣ר הַגָּ֑ר חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כָּכֶ֛ם כַּגֵּ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: One Torah/instruction and one judgment shall be for you and for sojourner who sojourns with you.

familiar.text: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

modern.text: The same law and the same ordinance will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing with you.”

original.text: תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר אִתְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: When you come into land where I bring you,

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you enter the land to which I am bringing you

original.text: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בְּבֹֽאֲכֶם֙ אֶל הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: when you eat from bread of land, you shall lift up a contribution to YHWH.

familiar.text: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.

modern.text: and you eat the food of the land, you shall lift up an offering to the LORD.

original.text: וְהָיָ֕ה בַּאֲכָלְכֶ֖ם מִלֶּ֣חֶם הָאָ֑רֶץ תָּרִ֥ימוּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: First of your dough, a cake you shall lift up as contribution; as contribution of threshing floor, so you shall lift it.

familiar.text: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

modern.text: From the first of your dough, you are to lift up a cake as a contribution; offer it just like an offering from the threshing floor.

original.text: רֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵכֶ֔ם חַלָּ֖ה תָּרִ֣ימוּ תְרוּמָ֑ה כִּתְרוּמַ֣ת גֹּ֔רֶן כֵּ֖ן תָּרִ֥ימוּ אֹתָֽהּ

verses.restored: From first of your dough you shall give to YHWH a contribution throughout generations.

familiar.text: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.

modern.text: Throughout your generations, you are to give the LORD an offering from the first of your dough. Offerings for Unintentional Sins

original.text: מֵרֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה תְּרוּמָ֑ה לְדֹרֹ֖תֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: If you err and do not do all these commands that YHWH spoke to Moses,

familiar.text: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,

modern.text: Now if you stray unintentionally and do not obey all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses—

original.text: וְכִ֣י תִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: all that YHWH commanded you by hand of Moses, from day YHWH commanded and onward throughout generations,

familiar.text: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;

modern.text: all that the LORD has commanded you through Moses from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come—

original.text: אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִן הַיּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה וָהָ֖לְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: if from eyes of congregation it was done in error, all congregation shall make one young bull as burnt offering, soothing scent to YHWH, with its grain offering and drink offering according to judgment, and one male goat as sin/purification offering.

familiar.text: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

modern.text: and if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation, then the whole congregation is to prepare one young bull as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD, with its grain offering and drink offering according to the regulation, and one male goat as a sin offering.

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה אִ֣ם מֵעֵינֵ֣י הָעֵדָה֮ נֶעֶשְׂתָ֣ה לִשְׁגָגָה֒ וְעָשׂ֣וּ כָל הָעֵדָ֡ה פַּ֣ר בֶּן בָּקָר֩ אֶחָ֨ד לְעֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָת֥וֹ וְנִסְכּ֖וֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּֽת

verses.restored: Priest shall make atonement/covering for all congregation of children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, for error it was; they brought their offering, fire-offering to YHWH, and their sin/purification offering before YHWH for their error.

familiar.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:

modern.text: The priest is to make atonement for the whole congregation of Israel, so that they may be forgiven; for the sin was unintentional and they have brought to the LORD an offering made by fire and a sin offering, presented before the LORD for their unintentional sin.

original.text: וְכִפֶּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עַֽל כָּל עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנִסְלַ֣ח לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי שְׁגָגָ֣ה הִ֔וא וְהֵם֩ הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֶת קָרְבָּנָ֜ם אִשֶּׁ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֗ה וְחַטָּאתָ֛ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עַל שִׁגְגָתָֽם

verses.restored: It shall be forgiven all congregation of children of Israel and sojourner sojourning in their midst, for in error all people were involved.

familiar.text: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

modern.text: Then the whole congregation of Israel and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, since it happened to all the people unintentionally.

original.text: וְנִסְלַ֗ח לְכָל עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם כִּ֥י לְכָל הָעָ֖ם בִּשְׁגָגָֽה

verses.restored: If one soul/life sins/misaligns in error, he shall bring female goat, daughter of a year, as sin/purification offering.

familiar.text: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

modern.text: Also, if one person sins unintentionally, he is to present a year-old female goat as a sin offering.

original.text: וְאִם נֶ֥פֶשׁ אַחַ֖ת תֶּחֱטָ֣א בִשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְהִקְרִ֛יבָה עֵ֥ז בַּת שְׁנָתָ֖הּ לְחַטָּֽאת

verses.restored: Priest shall make atonement/covering for soul/life who erred in sinning/misaligning in error before YHWH, to make covering for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

familiar.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

modern.text: And the priest shall make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the person who erred by sinning unintentionally; and when atonement has been made for him, he will be forgiven.

original.text: וְכִפֶּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עַל הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶ֛גֶת בְּחֶטְאָ֥ה בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖יו וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ

verses.restored: For native among children of Israel and for sojourner sojourning in their midst, one Torah/instruction shall be for you for one who acts in error.

familiar.text: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

modern.text: You shall have the same law for the one who acts in error, whether he is a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.

original.text: הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם תּוֹרָ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם לָעֹשֶׂ֖ה בִּשְׁגָגָֽה

verses.restored: But soul/life who acts with raised hand, from native or from sojourner, reviles YHWH; that soul/life shall be cut off from midst of its people.

familiar.text: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

modern.text: But the person who sins defiantly, whether a native or foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That person shall be cut off from among his people.

translation_notes: The chapter looks beyond wilderness judgment toward future settled life, offerings, bread, and remembrance.
Sojourner and native are placed under one statute and one instruction in worship and inadvertent-sin provisions; this must not be narrowed into ethnic exclusion.
First-dough contribution sanctifies ordinary food production and household labor.
The text distinguishes inadvertent error from deliberate raised-hand defiance.
The Sabbath wood-gatherer execution is severe ancient legal material. The holding period before judgment shows process, but the sentence must never authorize modern religious violence.
Tassels and blue cord are embodied memory aids, not markers of superiority or permission to police others' clothing.
Verse 39's 'scout after heart and eyes' echoes the scouting language of chapter 13 and redirects perception toward covenant remembrance.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 15 to justify execution for Sabbath violation, vigilantism, xenophobia, legalistic domination, or policing religious dress. Preserve the ancient legal text while centering equal law, forgiveness for error, embodied remembrance, and Exodus liberation.
